entries.developer_comments: ~ Description of mutation 'The Night Shines Like the Day'
identity: Your eyes have fully adapted to the darkness, allowing you to see as well in the dark as humans see in the light.  However, the light of the sun is dazzling now.
entries.singular: Your eyes have fully adapted to the darkness, allowing you to see as well in the dark as humans see in the light.  However, the light of the sun is dazzling now.

identity: Your dreams are filled with nothing but blood and drinking it.  As long as you are a vampire, your growth as a fae will be blocked.

   The user will return to their reality, then be extracted by AltarOS remote after the estimated time, 4 EARTH HOURS, has elapsed.

   Repeated visits will reattune the user to their own reality.  ᵖᵣₒᵐᵢˢₑ
   WARNING: Dimensional instability will make ᴴᵁᴹᴬᴺ communication impossible.

entries.developer_comments: ~ Description of compact bionic module 'Bionic Left Leg (Cyberframe 1a)'
identity: A bionic left leg and foot fit for an Exodii Cyberframe.  These bionics mimic the dynamics of normal human limbs, but are immune to temperature and pain, don't bleed, and are highly resistant to damage.  Due to their size and armored plating, a heavy-duty 1a-style Cyberframe is necessary for operation.
